name: svg-icon-kit
description: Turn a folder of SVG icons from different designers and tools into one tidy icon set. It strips editor leftovers from Inkscape, Sketch, Figma and Illustrator, removes scripts and event handlers, adds a missing viewBox, pads icons to a square and makes single-colour icons use currentColor so they take the text colour. Rename icons, recolour them or keep their original colours, then export optimised SVGs, one sprite.svg, React components and a preview page. Runs locally; no upload or API keys.
